raw.details:
Innovate. Build. Secure the Future.

ActTrident invites passionate developers, students, AI enthusiasts and technology innovators to participate in the ActTrident AI Hackathon 2026 — an online innovation challenge designed to encourage the development of intelligent, secure and impactful technology solutions.

Under the theme Building a Safer and Smarter Digital Future with AI, participants will explore emerging technologies and solve real-world challenges through artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, intelligent automation and digital trust.

Innovation Tracks:

  • AI-Powered Cybersecurity
  • Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
  • Software Supply Chain Security & Policy Enforcement
  • Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)
  • Open Innovation

Eligibility:

  • Undergraduate and postgraduate students.

  • Fresh graduates and aspiring technology professionals.

  • Developers and AI enthusiasts.

  • Individual participants or teams of up to four members.

  • Participants from different institutions may form teams.

Competition Structure:

Round 1 — Idea Innovation & System Architecture (2–6 December 2026)

  • Participants will submit a project proposal outlining their problem statement, proposed solution, system architecture, technology stack, innovation and expected impact.

Round 2 — Build, Engineer & Innovate (9–16 December 2026)

  • Shortlisted teams will develop a functional prototype and submit their source code, technical documentation and demonstration video.

Round 3 — Grand Finale & Technical Defence (19 December 2026)

  • Finalists will present their working solutions before an expert judging panel and participate in a live technical discussion.

Important Dates:

  • Registration deadline: 5 December 2026
  • Round 1 begins: 6 December 2026
  • Round 1 shortlist: 10 December 2026
  • Round 2 begins: 12 December 2026
  • Finalist announcement: 18 December 2026
  • Grand finale: 19 December 2026
  • Winner announcement: 20 December 2026

Participation Guidelines:

  • Participation is free.
  • The hackathon will be conducted entirely online.
  • All submissions must demonstrate original work and meaningful participant contributions.
  • Participants may use AI tools, open-source technologies and publicly available datasets, subject to applicable licences.
  • Participants must be able to explain their technical implementation during evaluation.
  • Projects must follow responsible AI, cybersecurity and data privacy principles.

Join ActTrident in building intelligent solutions that contribute to a safer, smarter and more trustworthy digital future.
